title: Ollama
description: Run high-performance open-source large language models (Llama 3, Mistral, Gemma, Phi) entirely locally on macOS, Linux, and Windows with a single command.
features: One-click CLI installer with GPU acceleration (Metal, CUDA, ROCm)
Extensive library of quantized GGUF models ready for instant execution
Modelfile syntax for customizing system prompts and temperature params
Native integration with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and Ollama WebUI
pros: Zero data leakage or cloud API costs
Blazing-fast inference on Apple Silicon and modern NVIDIA GPUs
Frictionless setup with instant model downloading
cons: Requires substantial local RAM/VRAM for 70B+ parameter models
Limited built-in multi-tenant access control without fronting proxies
targetAudience: Developers, AI researchers, and privacy-conscious teams needing local LLM inference.
